paper_metadata.title: Characterizing asymmetric and bimodal long-term financial return distributions through quantum walks

experiments.description: Discrete-time quantum walk fit of long-term bimodal financial return distributions at two trading years using fixed walk length n=100.

algorithm.variant: Discrete-time quantum walk distribution fitting for financial return distributions
algorithm.convergence_criteria: Optimal parameters identified to precision of 0.0001 radians

hyperparameters.position_smoothing: aggregate each three consecutive positions j with non-zero probability into one point

algorithm.parameter_initialization: Large set of initial parameter guesses covering parameter space with low resolution

optimizer_settings.search_strategy: local search with progressively narrowed parameter space

problem_formulation.encoding_details: Quantum walk position basis states |j> represent return support after rescaling; initial position fixed at j=0
problem_formulation.objective_function: Minimize mean absolute error between empirical return histogram Pe(i) and quantum-walk histogram PQW(i)

problem_instance.description: Fit empirical logarithmic return distributions at delta t = 504 trading days (2 trading years) for selected assets with pronounced bimodality
problem_instance.dataset_name: Yahoo Finance asset price time series

dataset_specification.date_range: up to 30 calendar years ending 2024-10-14 or earlier depending on asset availability
preprocessing: treat consecutive trading days as successive time points
bin return distributions into a small number of bins

classical_postprocessing: rescale quantum-walk position axis to match empirical return scale

speedup_claims.caveats: No computational speedup claim is made; the paper reports fit quality only.

problem_instance.description: Refined fit of the same long-term return distributions at delta t = 504 trading days for the 12 highlighted assets, using averaging over random walk lengths
problem_instance.dataset_name: Yahoo Finance asset price time series
